title: People Posing on Bridge, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: 457 Vergil Vanhoozer sister-in-law Lila Van Hoozer her brother Gene Dapp standing up
description: A 1930s outdoor snapshot depicting three family members on a wooden truss bridge. Gene Dapp stands in the center wearing a boater hat and holding structural support cables, while Vergil and Lila Van Hoozer sit casually on the bridge railing above a river.
